name: failure-memory
description: Qualify real agent failures, diagnose root causes, preserve durable lessons locally, and recall recurrence-prevention guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Learn from real failures without recording requirement changes.
interface.longDescription: Distinguishes real failures from requirement changes, records evidence-bounded root causes and repair recommendations, stores immutable incidents and versioned proposed lessons in one owner-private global memory, and recalls recurrence-prevention guidance across trusted agent harnesses.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate whether this correction is a real failure.
Recall relevant lessons before I continue.
